analysis: The only change in this PR is a one-line documentation edit at docs/operations/provider-release.md line 631. It updates the stated release SDK from 27.0 / Apple Swift 6.4 to 27.2 / Apple Swift 6.4.2 (Xcode 27.2). No code, workflow, signing, attestation, coordinator-contract or key-handling behavior changes in the supplied evidence. I read the surrounding signing, staging and registration section, which states that the final recorded SDK must match the selected SDK. That check lives in release scripts and workflows, none of which are in this batch. The doc therefore does not weaken any control. It does imply a toolchain change in the build and signing pipeline (T-034 and T-054, TB-011 build qualification), but the workflow, action and script edits that would implement it are not supplied. I cannot confirm the doc matches the actual pinned SDK selection or that qualification covers the new SDK. This is a coverage limit, not a finding. A later pass should check that the build-and-release workflow, the qualify-sdk selection and the recorded-SDK verification agree with 27.2, and that the toolchain is pinned or checksum-verified. No new attack surface, no invalidated threat-model assumption and no threat-model gap is identified from this doc-only edit.
